assumptions.adverse_selection: 0.25 of the half-spread is deducted from the reported expected maker edge (edge_bps). The maker ledger uses conservative marks (exit price) instead of mid, so a resting fill shows no spread-capture until it can be exited.
assumptions.ex_post_limits: Trades page newest-first with a per-market cap (trades_truncated); markets are the inference unit (clustered SE); series fee parameters are as of harvest time.
assumptions.fee_model: Kalshi July-2026 schedule: taker round_up(M*0.07*C*P*(1-P)); maker round_up(M*0.0175*C*P*(1-P)) on quadratic_with_maker_fees series; M = series fee_multiplier (1 default, 0.5 on some game series). Rounded to a centicent on paper fills, unrounded per contract in the ex-post table.
assumptions.fill_probability: Maker fills are expected-value fills floor(qty*p): p=0.50 when improving the touch by one tick, p=0.25*own/(own+displayed) when joining the touch. Not measured; a live resting order fills fully or not at all.
assumptions.longshot_definition: A side priced strictly below 0.20 at the touch (YES ask, or 1 - YES bid for NO). Bands are by price: <10c, 10-20c, ..., >=90c; the ex-post table buckets by the price the taker paid.
assumptions.marks: Fade track marked at mid; maker track marked conservatively (longs at bid, shorts at ask). Positions without a two-sided book are valued at cost and counted as unmarked.
assumptions.queue: Joining the touch assumes pro-rata position behind the displayed size; improving assumes first in queue at the new price. Book depth beyond the touch is ignored for resting orders.
assumptions.sizing: Whole contracts; $25/order, $75 cash-at-risk per market and $1000 total collateral (strategy), plus 75 contracts/market + $75 daily loss (RiskManager). Per-order/market/daily caps mirror the caps decided for a later live canary; the total cap equals the paper starting cash so the ledger never borrows.
assumptions.snapshot_limits: Open books contain no outcomes; FLB cannot be identified from a snapshot. Snapshot checks quantify take cost by band and event overround only.

kalshi_longshot_fade.label: Kalshi longshot fade (taker)
kalshi_longshot_fade.notes: Taker fade of every Kalshi longshot (<=20c side): buys the favourite at the touch, pays the taker fee, marked at mid. The shadow_longshot_buyer metric is the mirror trade. Paper caps $25/order, $75/market, $75 daily.

shadow_longshot_buyer.note: Mirror of every fade: takes the longshot at its ask with the same $25/$75 caps. Hypothetical benchmark only; never proposed to the risk-gated engine.

kalshi_maker_quote.label: Kalshi maker quote (resting fade)
kalshi_maker_quote.notes: Resting fade one tick inside the spread (or joining the touch). Fills are expected-value fills from documented fill-probability assumptions, maker fee 0.0175*M*P*(1-P) where the series charges makers, conservative marks (exit price). Not a measurement of fill rates.
